summary: Test gap (mutation probe of is_usage at d3a270f7): two parts of the rule are pinned only by tests of other rows. Allowing a code a command document declares to stand for USAGE fails only atip_checkl1_04 (L1.tree's owner case) and leaving the stateless test's field unfiltered (any pointer, not only --name) fails only atip_checkl2input_13; atip_checkl2safety_04 and atip_checkl2input_07 kill the other mutants (ignore field, reserved code, any exit, no OPTION_INVALID in L1.registry). Dropping the !code.starts_with(INPUT_) guard survives everything: every INPUT_* code the contract reserves is also excluded by reserved_code, so the guard only matters for an unreserved INPUT_* name (equivalent for the spec's codes). Add a seeded case: a command that declares code X on a constraint with field --name, refused with X by a half (L2.destructive-half must not read it as USAGE), and a registered unreserved INPUT_FOO at exit 2 with an argument field.
